accepted_cases: login page returns HTTP 200 but no business data; is_success=false and is_real_empty=false

model catalog flag and current protocol stay UNVERIFIED when they disagree

every source has an owner and at least one module-level readiness conclusion
every fixture is synthetic and every schema sample/rejection sample is executed

limits: Offline evidence package only: no real campus login, read, booking, payment or submission was performed.
